body: Another issue where 404 is returned due to malformed url containing `/_/` https://github.com/cypress-io/cypress/issues/4472
I can recreate this issue from the original code provided in the main comment. This is still happening in 3.3.2 pre-release version.

Since this issue only exhibits itself within Chrome - we figure it is a change in Chrome that caused this issue to happen in Cypress. I also assume it is not a bug, as the issue still persists in version 77. It may be an intended change in behavior. 

Narrowing down the version of Chrome that it was introduced, it was introduce in version 71.0.3572.0, specifically between commits 7e3da6dc3d7cd7eb8a55ef301026fe1ab737f814 and 56dd83c9005f68d55ddbf85c551759526b4e37cd:

- Chrome 61.0.3163.100 - PASSES
- Chrome 69.0.3452.0 - PASSES
- Chrome 71.0.3572.0 - PASSES = Base = 597039 7e3da6dc3d7cd7eb8a55ef301026fe1ab737f814
- Chrome 71.0.3572.0 - FAILS = Base = 597057 56dd83c9005f68d55ddbf85c551759526b4e37cd
- Chrome 72.0.3583.0 - FAILS
- Chrome 73.0.3683.0 - FAILS
- Chrome 74.0.3729.0 - FAILS
- Chrome 77.0.3833.0 - FAILS

⭐️ 	**[Changelog where issue was introduced](https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+log/7e3da6dc3d7cd7eb8a55ef301026fe1ab737f814..56dd83c9005f68d55ddbf85c551759526b4e37cd?pretty=fuller&n=10000)**

@flotwig good luck 😅

labels.name: type: duplicate
labels.description: This issue or pull request already exists

repository.name: cypress
repository.description: Fast, easy and reliable testing for anything that runs in a browser.

issue.body:
## Current behavior:

When I login through normal browser then I am able to login.
But when running from cypress test runner the directory path is missing from URL.

**The Cypress Test Runner redirects to : http://<ip>:8084/__/adminHome.html**

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/26091432/68003324-dde97480-fc92-11e9-880e-7e9e4b4c4cb1.png)


### Desired behavior:

**The Cypress Test Runner should redirect to : http://<ip>:8084/<directory>/adminHome.html**

### Steps to reproduce: (app code and test code)

Below is the code:

```js
cy.visit("http://<ip>:8084/<directory>")
cy.get("#login").click()
cy.get("input[value='Organization']").click()
cy.get("#username").type('<User name provided>')
cy.get("#pwd").type('<password provided>')
cy.get("#login").click()
```


### Versions

Cypress Version : 3.5.0
Operating System : Windows 10
Browser : Chrome 77 / Electron 73
